title: Choose the visual world for SUTURE — roll 3
question: The new roll assigned the Live Service Map. Keep it, take the alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: The Live Service Map
options.lineage: metro maps & live transit status systems
options.thesis: Lineage as a transit network: positions are stations, the policy thread is the line, revocation suspends service, remediation is the shuttle.
options.viewport: A backlit service map with pulses moving along the policy line, suspension tape across the cut section, and an advisory strip below.
options.risk: Reads playful if the transit metaphor decorates instead of carrying state; every map device must mean something.

options.label: Split-Flap Board
options.thesis: The console as a clacking incident board: every status change cascades down the flaps.
options.case: Fuses cleanly for events and statuses; the lineage graph has no native form.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: The dark institutional dashboard, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: Sidebar, KPI cards, neutral table — the arrangement a reviewer expects, at full craft.
